summary: folder-lint 1.0.8 preinstall executes obfuscated Bun payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub release (pinned v1.3.13) to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js` under Bun; if Bun is already present locally, it invokes `math_init.js` under the existing Bun instead. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with hex-obfuscated identifiers, a large numeric/string constant table, and a `WV8StW` string-array rotator — the standard obfuscator.io output shape. The `lib/` directory contains the legitimate ServiceTitan folder-lint TypeScript compiled output, but `package.json` has been modified to add the preinstall hook and the tarball ships two extra top-level files (`setup.mjs`, `math_init.js`) that are not declared in `files` and are unrelated to the advertised folder-lint functionality. The README is a placeholder (`> TODO: description`). A folder-lint utility has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate runtime and run an opaque obfuscated payload at install time; using Bun as the executor also evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code.
